description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class named FeaturesNotAccessibleException within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions package. The class indicates that requested features do not exist or access rights are insufficient. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder for flexible construction.

classes.name: FeaturesNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception indicating features are not accessible due to absence or insufficient permissions. It includes static methods for building instances from messages or JSON and contains an inner Builder class for flexible object creation.
